title: Four One-on-One Duels
summary: Mo Longzi dismisses Mu Chen as merely Heavenly Transformation, sparing him only because the Dragon Demon Palace needs the Great Xumi Demonic Pillar, and boasts he will prove the palace has more than Mo Xingtian. The two sides agree to four duels to the death: Luo Li takes Mu Gu, Mu Chen takes Wu Jia, Shen Cangsheng faces Mo Longzi, and Li Xuantong takes Gui Xiong. Mu Gu flees to buy time and Luo Li chases him. Mu Chen easily breaks Wu Jia's formations, having trained against Ling Xi's, and matches him in close combat, then sees through the Nine Mountains and Rivers Formation, which Wu Jia says has killed 13 Heavenly Completion experts. Mo Longzi mocks Shen Cangsheng as the first on the Heavenly Ranking, and Shen answers with the Judgment Divine Art and the Spear of Judgment.
events: Mo Longzi taunts Mu Chen's Heavenly Transformation level.
Mu Gu flees from Luo Li to stall.
Mu Chen breaks Wu Jia's formations and his Golden Bell Formation.
Mu Chen sees through the Nine Mountains and Rivers Formation.
Shen Cangsheng uses the Judgment Divine Art against Mo Longzi.
